## Zip 23: Totals refresh (TOTALS_REFRESH, ships OFF), Mon Nov 9, 2026
Admin only, display only. No database change, no new cost. Branch `claude/new-session-kytbmu` (the brief's name "🎾23.totals" is the session name).

### What it is
- Money > Totals redone from Alex's mock (`mockups/totals_mock.html`, copied value by value, px that hold text written as rem so big text scales): a "So far"
  card (yellow accent) and a "Projected" card (slate blue), each Membership (monthly), Court costs (N games), Owed to venue (amber), Players paid / pay
  (green, minus), then a tinted bottom row (card name with an 8 px dot, plain gray "$21/court", bold 20 px total); then one collapsed "Month by month" card.
- Numbers are the server's `rework` answer untouched. The total is owed minus players paid (= "Your cost so far" / "Your estimated cost" whenever that is
  above $0). New: per court = total / games on that card, whole dollars, nearest with halves up (the same `Math.round(cents/100)` Settings and Short games use
  for money shown to the organizer; player prices floor, but that is a rule about what players are charged). 0 games: no per-court text at all.
- Month by month: closed, it loads nothing. Opened, one row per past month (every month from the first game up to last month, newest first, same list as the
  month box): month, games, net cost, $/court, or "No games".
- Font fix: every number on the screen is in the site's body font (the Games rows' and date tiles' font) with equal-width digits. The old big totals used the
  display font (Bricolage); the new screen does not.
- Switch: `TOTALS_REFRESH` (kill switch in `[vars]` and `[env.preview.vars]`), Settings > Feature switches > "Totals refresh" (top row), `/admin?totalsrefresh=on`
  per phone, Activity lines. The preview database has the row ON (one INSERT of the row on the fake database, not a re-seed; `BUILDING_ON` also has it for the next seed).

### Choices
- A total below $0 (players paid more than the venue is owed) is a green credit ("$8 credit", "$4/court credit"), never a minus sign. The server's own "your cost"
  stops at $0 and the old screen shows $0 there; the new screen works from owed minus paid so it can say credit. Players redo's "Spent" still clamps at $0 per month
  (so a credit month counts as $0 there): not changed in this zip.
- A credit that rounds to $0 per court reads plain "$0/court".
- Month by month starts at the first month with a listed game (like the month box). Months from October 2026 owe the $30 membership even with no game, so a
  membership-only month BEFORE the first listed game has no row.
- The Month by month tap row is 42 px tall (the mock). Everything else matches the mock; the real header and bottom bar are the site's, not the mock's.

### Tests

## Zip 22: cleanup (the always-failing browser tests, the folded TONIGHT tile) - built Mon Nov 9, 2026

Spec: the "zip 22" brief (`START_HERE.md`, `SITE_RULES.md`). No database change, no migration, no new switch, no new cost. Site change: one CSS
value (admin only). Built on main `cc2ccb7` (Zip 18 and Zip 23 live).

### Item 1 (games that end after midnight): built, then DROPPED (Alex, after the preview, Mon Nov 9)
- Cause found: Edit game and Add game put the End on the start's date, so 11:00 PM to 1:00 AM became 1:00 AM that same morning and the
  server refused it. A fix was built and reviewed (first PR #112 version), but the venue closes at 10:00 PM (7:00 PM on Sunday), so no game
  can run past midnight, and a "Next day" End list would invite bookings that cannot happen. Edit game and Add game are exactly main's.

## Zip 24: Booking hours (BOOKING_HOURS, ships OFF) and tap-to-pick game times, Mon Nov 9, 2026
Admin only. No database change, no new cost, no money logic changed. Branch `claude/new-session-u3aoty` (the brief's name "🎾24.hours" is the session name). Built on main `cc2ccb7`. NOT deployed: 🎾22 (PR #112, Add game / Edit game after-midnight work) had not landed on main when this was built; both change the same two sheets, so rebase, rerun everything, then deploy.

### What it is
- The venue is open 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 7:00 PM Sunday (Eastern, the game's own date). One table, `VENUE_HOURS` in `shared/bookingHours.ts`; everything reads it.
- A game outside those hours is BLOCKED: Add game (new game), Edit game (only a CHANGED start or end) and Settings > Schedule > Usual game time (only a changed time, against Tuesday's hours). The server checks all three (`server/bookingHours.ts`, 400 `invalid_time`); seconds count (an end of 10:00:30 PM is refused). An existing game is never blocked or changed because of it.
- Add game and Edit game: tap-to-pick times from Alex's mock (card with Date/Court, Start/End, Length; Note or Label card; Start opens a grid with AM/PM labels, chips every 30 minutes, 4 across). Out-of-hours times cannot be offered; a start or a length that would pass closing is faded, dashed and cannot be tapped ("past close" on a length). Edit game loses only the "Cancel by ... set automatically" line (the cancel logic is untouched).
- Settings > Schedule keeps its time boxes: with the switch on, the message "The venue is open 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM (Sundays 8:00 AM to 7:00 PM). Pick times inside those hours." shows under the boxes and Save is off while the times are outside the hours. (Chosen over reusing the picker: it is the smaller and safer change.)

### Pricing check (the code is the truth; what the money code does for each length)
- Length is `gameMinutes(startsAt, endsAt)` (End minus Start). Cancel-by is start minus 12 hours for every length. The calendar file writes the game's own end time for every length. The texts say the length in words for every length.
- First finding (before Alex's OK): only 1.5 hr and 2 hr had price rows. 1 hr, 2.5 hr and 3 hr were priced like a 2 hour game ($14 up front, the 2 hour final table and credit, court $48 on Money > Totals instead of $60 / $72). So the picker first shipped with only 1.5 and 2 hr and no money logic changed.
- Alex then OKed full support (Mon Nov 9, afternoon): two new rows in `GAME_LENGTHS`, same shape as the 1.5 hour row.
  - 1.5 hr (Short games): $11 up front, final 11/9/7/6/5/4/4 for 4 to 10 in, court $36. Handled.
  - 2 hr (Settings > Money): $14, floor(4 x 14 / N) = 14/11/9/8/7/6/5, court $48. Handled.
  - 2.5 hr (Booking hours row ON for everyone): $18 up front (14 x 2.5 / 2 = 17.5, rounded up), final floor(4 x 18 / N) = 18/14/12/10/9/8/7, credit back = the difference (N = 5: $4, 6: $6, 7: $8, 8: $9), court $60. Handled.
  - 3 hr (same gate): $21 up front, final floor(84 / N) = 21/16/14/12/10/9/8 (credit back N = 5: $5, 6: $7, 7: $9, 8: $11), court $72. Handled.
  - 1 hr: still no row ($14, court $48); not one of the four buttons; an existing 1 hour game opens in Edit game with its own times and no length picked.
- Answer to "does the existing rule give different numbers": the 1.5 hour row is a fixed table, not a formula. floor(4 x 11 / N) would give 11/8/7/6/5/4/4; the table has $9 at 5 in (Alex OKed those numbers in Zip 9). The 2 hour table IS the formula. The new rows use the formula (up front rounded up, then floor(4 x up-front / N) in whole dollars), as Alex described.
- Guards: (a) read-only look at live: only 90 and 120 minute games exist (13), none of 150 or 180; preview: 60, 90, 120; so no existing game can change. (b) no schema change. (c) the rows apply only to 150 and 180 minute games. (d) the rows count only while the Booking hours row is ON for everyone and the kill switch allows it; the private link never prices; OFF = main including money (`e2e/zip24-off.cjs` compares a 2.5 and a 3 hour game against main). (e) tests: `tests/long-games.test.ts` (25) and the four-button browser checks. (f) a fresh reviewer read the money change (see below).

### Choices and things to know
- Wording under the picker follows the mock (no heads-up box, no "New time:" line, no quick-date chips). The one conditional line kept is "Players who are in will be asked to confirm the new time." (only when a start with players in is changed).
- A new date with other hours moves the start into that day's hours if it no longer fits (a Tuesday 8:00 PM start moved to a Sunday becomes 5:00 PM for 2 hr); big text turns the 4-across grid into 3 across.
- Not covered on purpose: the 5-minute game generator (`ensureSessions`) still builds Tuesday and Thursday games from the saved usual time without a check; a usual time that was already out of hours before the switch went on would keep generating such games until it is changed (Settings blocks only a CHANGE).
- Review (a fresh reviewer, the date and time rule): nothing blocking; one fix made (seconds), notes above.

### Switch
`BOOKING_HOURS` kill switch in `[vars]` and `[env.preview.vars]`; Settings > Feature switches > "Booking hours" (top row); `/admin?bookinghours=on` per phone (sends `X-Booking-Hours`, honored by the server for that phone's saves); Activity lines; `docs/FEATURE_SWITCHES.md`. The preview database gets the row with one INSERT (no re-seed); `BUILDING_ON` has it for the next seed.

### Tests
- `tests/booking-hours.test.ts` (44): the hours table, every boundary both sides, Sunday, midnight, DST, seconds, picker slots and length fit (including a 2.5 hr game from 4:30 PM Sunday ending exactly 7:00 PM), prices per length (1.5, 2, and the unsupported 1, 2.5, 3), the switch, server refusals for Add game, Edit time and Settings, old out-of-hours games still cancel / edit / save unchanged.
- `e2e/zip24.cjs` (20): the mock's structure, fit on 420 x 912, 38 px targets, grid rules, dark green chip, length buttons and prices from the server, saved times, court pick, Edit game (status first, no Cancel-by line, own start and length, odd lengths, old out-of-hours game), Settings message and Save, server refusals, strict clipping at 390/360/320, light and dark, text 100/125/150% (proven to fail on purpose-broken CSS).
- `e2e/zip24-off.cjs` (needs `MAIN_DIR`): switch OFF equals main for Add game, Edit game, the Usual game time sheet, Settings, Home, Players, Money, History, and the answers.

## Zip 27: money safety fixes from Audit A (A-01 to A-05), Mon Nov 9, 2026
Branch `claude/new-session-xud79r` (the brief's name "🎾27.money" is the session name). Built on main `d290376`. No schema change, no migration, no new cost. Audit: `docs/audits/AUDIT_A_2026-11.md` on PR #117.

### What changed
- A-01 (no switch): a game keeps the price rules it was finalized under. At Finalize the up-front price, the court cost and the length row are written to `task_log` (task `price_lock`, the game's own row; `server/repo.ts` `priceLockStatements`, in the Finalize batch). `priceOf` reads the lock first, so every price path (Totals, the game row, no-show debts, Reopen and the redo) keeps it. Games finalized before this zip, and canceled games, get their lock right before Short games or Booking hours is switched or "Price per player" / "Typical court cost" is saved (`lockFinalizedGames`, from what they show at that moment, using the rules for everyone, never a test phone's private link). Reopen of a canceled game drops its lock. The lock never reaches the screen (`loadMarks` skips it). Not in backup files (like all of `task_log`).
- A-02 (no switch): a seat paid below its fee now (game made longer, or Booking hours raised it, after the payment) owes the rest on a late cancel with the fee kept (split or not), a late drop that leaves the game short, and a no-show. The cash is held on the seat the way Finalize already does it (`server/credit.ts` `holdShortCashStatements`; finalize.ts no-show branch). Not covered on purpose: a price LOWERED after a cash payment and then a late fee keeps the higher payment until Alex clears it (Zip 9 known gap b).
- A-03 (no switch): `scripts/integrity-checks.sql` `credit_on_seat_over_14` compares with MAX($21, Settings price); a test ties $21 to `GAME_LENGTHS`. The column name is kept.
- A-04 (no switch): Remove answers 409 `player_in_games` ("Casey is still in 2 games (Tue, Nov 10 and Thu, Nov 12). Take Casey out of them first (gear > Players), then remove the name.") while the player is confirmed or waiting in a game that is not canceled and has not ended.
- A-05 (switch `SPENT_TOTALS`, ships OFF): see `docs/FEATURE_SWITCHES.md`. Totals and Spent share `server/seatMoney.ts`.

### Before/after proof
- `tests/zip27-world.ts` builds one fake world (12 games of 1.5, 2, 2.5 and 3 hours in October and November, cash and credit, a fee-kept late cancel with the split, a late drop, a no-show, an open game ahead), twice: live switches, and live plus Booking hours. Run on main and on the branch (`tests/zip27-dump.gen.test.ts`, `ZIP27_DUMP_OUT=...`): 0 differences in every Money month, game row, player screen, pot and Spent. Main's dump is `tests/fixtures/zip27-main-dump.json`; `tests/zip27-money.test.ts` checks the branch against it every run.
- Then every price rule changed at once (Short games off, Booking hours off, Price per player $15, Typical court cost $50): main moves 55 settled numbers (59 with Booking hours), the branch 0.

### Tests
- `tests/zip27-money.test.ts` (34): the proof; A-01 flip, Reopen + redo, lock rules, old games locked before a change, canceled reopen; A-02 cancel (split off, split 4 and 6 in), late drop + sub, no-show, Booking hours raise, no-change case; A-03; A-04; A-05 switch, sums equal Totals, credit month; Second Chance with Booking hours ON (and A-11 pinned as `it.fails`, not fixed here); every length for N = 1 to 10, organizer in and out.
- Browser: `money-rework.cjs`, `zip16.cjs`, `zip23.cjs` know the new top Settings row.

### Fresh review (an independent reviewer who did not write the code)
- Nothing that moves wrong money. Fixed from it: (1) the lock lookup scanned all of `task_log` for every game loaded (the only index is partial); it now repeats the index's own condition and reads one row per game (checked with EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN); (2) a late drop on a seat paid below the fee said "Your $14 stays on this game"; the drop dialog, its answer and the Texts R2 alert now say the $3 owed; (3) the lock writes before a switch or money save go 20 games per batch, each only while its game is still finalized or canceled. Also: a database with no `task_log` (before migration 0015) reads the games without locks, as before.
- Notes kept: a late drop made BEFORE the game was made longer still reads paid at the old price (the hold happens when the fee is made); a no-show whose seat has an unconfirmed "I paid" below the price is left as a claim; the `wrangler.toml` kill switches for Short games and Booking hours cannot write locks first, so a game finalized before Zip 27 and never locked would still re-price on a kill-switch deploy (any Settings flip or money save locks them all); with "Fewer database trips" off, the new switch adds one switch read to the dashboard and the player sheet (answered by the shared read when it is on, as on live).

### Test runs (Mon Nov 9, 2026, evening, final code)
- Unit, full suite alone, twice. Run 1: 4 failed, all from this zip (an old-database test hit the new lock lookup, the trip count knew no new row, and two older tests expected a finalized game to re-price after a Settings change); all fixed (the two older tests now expect the A-01 rule, with a comment). Run 2: 2640 passed, 2 failed (those two), 2 skipped on purpose; the two then pass (72/72 in their files). tsc and build clean.
- Browser, the full `npm run test:e2e` list plus zip21 and zip27, once, 4 at a time: 64 scripts, 2233 of 2244 checks. Then alone: round2 25/25 and zip24 26/26 (load and connection flakes in the parallel run); audit-player-flows 93/93 after it takes the player out of upcoming games before Remove (A-04 refuses otherwise); zip27 14/14. Left as they are: zip21 2/8 fails the same on main (it expects Error alerts as the top Settings row; two newer rows already sit above it there); money-rework check 6 (Hide from list) failed 2 of 5 runs on the branch and 0 of 5 on main. The server answers it as fast as main (dashboard about 11 ms on both), and when it passes the game leaves the screen 3 ms after the tap, so it looks like the check's fixed 0.9 second wait racing the 5-second refresh. Not fixed in this zip.
- Preview: https://preview-zip27.pickleball-club-9h0.pages.dev (deployment `caa25929`), the fake database NOT re-seeded; one INSERT turned the "Spent matches Totals" row on. Rows on there: every row on live, plus Booking hours, Totals refresh and Spent matches Totals.

### After Alex walked the preview (Tue Nov 10, 2026)
- All 3 taps good. Answers: (1) lock every game finalized before Zip 27 once, right at deploy, with a read-only check of every Totals month and every Spent number before and after (stop and undo if anything differs): `scripts/lock-finalized.ts` and `scripts/money-check.ts`, steps in `docs/DEPLOY.md`. (2) made cheaper after paying: a later zip. (3) A-11: a later zip. (4) "Typical court cost" is never assumed: it is read from Settings as before, and a lock stores whatever the game showed.

Cause, found by logging every press and tap: the check taps "Hide it" about 386 ms after "Hide from list", 23 px away, and the Instant taps double-tap guard (src/InstantTaps.tsx, 400 ms and 24 px) drops that tap on purpose. It passed only when the tap happened to come after 400 ms. Same on main; nothing in this zip touches it (dashboard about 11 ms on both). The check now waits 450 ms between the two taps, like a person: branch 20/20, main 20/20. Full script 36/36.

## Zip 30: phone tag and "Acting for others" (🎾30.phonetag, ACTING_FOR_OTHERS, ships OFF) - built Tue Nov 10, 2026 (night) to Wed Nov 11, 12:30 AM; on a preview, waiting for "ship it"
Branch `claude/new-session-kmm7br` (the brief's name "🎾30.phonetag" is the session name). Built on main `88a5356`. Organizer only, look only. No money or credit logic, no Telegram, no push, no new cost. ONE database change (Alex approved Tue Nov 10): migration `0018_phone_tag`. NOT deployed; the migration is on the fake preview database only.

### Why
A player used "Not you?" to sign up as another player, then changed it for him. Alex wants to SEE that quietly, not block or confirm it (no "Signing in as Brandon" step, no name lock: not built).

### What it is
1. Phone tag. Each phone makes a random code once (16 random bytes from the browser, not a fingerprint), keeps it in browser storage with a cookie copy (`pb_phone`, about 400 days; each copy restores the other), and sends it as `X-Phone-Tag` on player requests (never on organizer requests, never in View as or the demo copy). `server/phoneTag.ts` reads it from the request only (no database read) and `audit()` writes it into the History line the tap already makes: I'm in, Drop out, Still in, check-in, Can't make it, I paid, Didn't pay, Use credit, Undo credit, cash-out credit, refund request and its cancel, and the texted-link taps. No code when the request comes from a phone signed in as the organizer (that cookie is sent on every /api request from Alex's phone), in the demo copy, with a bad code, or with the kill switch "off". Codes are recorded whether the Settings row is on or off (the row only decides what the organizer screens show), so a phone already has its usual name the day the switch goes on.
2. History (Activity): a tap made for someone else gets a note, "Brandon said I'm in for Tue, Nov 10 (from Mitchel's phone)" or "(from a new phone)". Normal taps get nothing.
3. Home card "Acting for others" at the very top (mocks `acting_for_others_light.png` / `_dark.png`): gray circle with the swap arrows, bold title, X; rows "Mitchel signed up for Brandon" with the time on the right ("Mon 7:12 PM" for an earlier day); the last 7 days; up to 3 rows, then "+N more in History" (opens History); the X hides it on that phone (like the other Home card X's), History keeps every line, a newer tap brings the card back. Same surface, border, corners and shadow as the "Tue game" card. Gone when empty.
4. The rule (`shared/actingForOthers.ts` judgeTaps; each tap judged only on the taps before it): a phone's usual name is the only name it has acted as, from its first tap (changed Wed Nov 11, see below); once two or more names have used it, the name it acted as most once it has made at least 3 taps and more than half were as that name. A tap counts as "for someone else" when the phone has a usual name and acts as a different name ("from Mitchel's phone"), or when the phone is still too new (1 or 2 taps) and acts as a name it has never used ("from a new phone"). Never: a phone's first tap; a phone with a tie (two people sharing it equally); a phone Alex's own player name has acted from; the organizer's signed-in phone; View as; taps with no code. Two people sharing one phone are flagged both ways while one of them has more than half the taps, and it goes quiet at a tie.
5. Limits: a private window, cleared browser data (both copies), another browser or another device looks like a new phone. It cannot tell when someone uses the real owner's phone.

### Database
- `migrations/0018_phone_tag.sql`: `ALTER TABLE admin_audit_log ADD COLUMN device_tag TEXT;` and `CREATE INDEX idx_audit_phone ON admin_audit_log (group_id, created_at) WHERE device_tag IS NOT NULL;`. Additive only; every old line stays NULL; nothing filled, copied or rewritten.
- Reads added on player screens: zero (`tests/acting-others.test.ts` "NO extra database reads": the player answer makes the same queries with or without a code; a tap makes the same trips, only its History INSERT names one more column). Organizer screens, only while the switch is on: one read of the lines that have a code from the last 180 days (the index holds only those lines; checked on D1 with EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN: `SEARCH admin_audit_log USING INDEX idx_audit_phone`), plus the switch read (answered by the shared switch read when Fewer database trips is on, as on live).
- New code without the column (before 0018): the tap writes its line without the code (only the missing-column error is forgiven), organizer screens read nothing.
- Rollback: the site before Zip 30 (main `88a5356`) works unchanged on the migrated database, View as included (its demo copy leaves out columns its own tables lack, since Zip 14): `e2e/zip30-off.cjs` runs main on the migrated database and `tests/acting-others.test.ts` loads a backup with codes into a demo copy built without 0018. So a code rollback needs NO database step. Only to remove the column itself (deletes every phone code, nothing else), in this order: `DROP INDEX idx_audit_phone;` then `ALTER TABLE admin_audit_log DROP COLUMN device_tag;`.
- The codes are in backup files and the export (like the rest of History). They are random strings, not names, numbers or anything about the phone; no screen ever shows a code (only names).

### Switch
`ACTING_FOR_OTHERS` kill switch in `[vars]` and `[env.preview.vars]` ("off" also stops the recording); Settings > Feature switches > "Acting for others" (top row); `/admin?actingothers=on` per phone; Activity lines; `docs/FEATURE_SWITCHES.md`.

## Zip 31: Extended time (🎾31.extended, EXTENDED_TIME, ships OFF) - built Wed Nov 11, 2026; on a preview, waiting for "ship it"
Branch `claude/new-session-hj7h0d` (the brief's name "🎾31.extended" is the session name). Built on main `6d45848` (🎾29 live). 🎾30.phonetag (PR #122,
migration `0018_phone_tag`) was NOT merged when this was built: this zip's migration is numbered `0019` so it lands after 0018; it must deploy after 🎾30
(rebase on main, rerun the tests). MOVES MONEY. One database change (migration `0019_extended_time`, Alex approved the idea; the live migration waits for his
"ship it"). NOT deployed.

### The rule (shared/extension.ts)
- Extra court cost: $12 for +30 min, $24 for +1 hr, one court (two courts at once are two games, each with its own extension; no multiplier).
- N = everyone who played, Alex too if he played. Everyone who played except Alex pays ROUND UP(cost / N) whole dollars; Alex covers the rest (can be $0).
  If rounding up would collect more than the cost, the share is rounded DOWN. Alex absent: the same split, he covers the remainder. Not played: never charged.
- 4 / 5 / 6 played (Alex in): +30 min $3, $3, $2 each (Alex $3, $0, $2); +1 hr $6, $5, $4 (Alex $6, $4, $4). 9 played, +30 min: $1 each ($8), Alex $4.
- The game's own price (floor(4 x up-front / N)) is not touched; the share is a separate charge.

### What changed (all behind the switch)
1. Finalize card: "Change who played" reads "Edit players / time". "Everyone played" is the shortcut (no extension).
2. Who played sheet (option A, tiles; `src/pages/admin/ExtendedTime.tsx`, `src/extended-time.css`): "Who played · Thu, Nov 12" and the X; "4 played · $14 each"
   (live); two columns of big tiles (pickleball, bold name, "(you)" for Alex); on = green outline and a small check badge; off = gray name, dashed gray outline,
   no badge; EXTENDED TIME None | +30 min | +1 hr (the site's segmented control, None by default); +30 / +1 hr shows the soft amber "3 others pay $3 each" /
   "You cover $3"; Confirm. Many players: the tile grid scrolls inside the sheet, the rest stays in view; a narrow phone at big text gets one column.
   Everything the old sheet did is kept (price line, who can be toggled, the unconfirmed I paid warning, Undo on the toast, Reopen).
3. Money (`server/extension.ts`): the shares are set in the SAME all-or-nothing batch as the finalize, after its credit back. Each share lives on the player's own
   seat of that game (so it belongs to the person: dropping out of a later game, never playing again or reopening a later game never touches it). Setting a share
   is "move to this number": credit already on it plus cash already paid is compared with the new share; too much comes back as credit (a ledger 'kept' row),
   too little is owed again, and usable credit (never a pending cash out) is used at once for what is owed (a 'used' row). Both ledger rows carry reason
   `ext:<game id>` and NO session_id, so no seat of any game counts them. Reopen moves every share of that game to $0 first (credit back), then reopens; if the
   reopen stops, the shares are put back. An I paid on a share that is not confirmed stops a change that would hand it back ("Confirm it or clear it first"),
   the same rule Finalize already has. Court cost: the extra cost is written on the game at Finalize (`sessions.extra_cost_cents`).
4. Paying: the next game the player owes on (the soonest coming game they are in, unpaid, with an amount due; else none, the alert only) reads "$17 due" with
   "incl. $3 extension" at the right end of the I paid / Drop out row; Pay opens Venmo for $17; I paid claims both (`ext_via` = that seat), Alex's Mark paid on
   that seat confirms both, Unmark undoes both. "Pay now instead" on the alert opens the Pay sheet for just the extension; its I paid waits for Alex like every
   I paid. Home ("Extra time: 1 hasn't paid") and the Money game card list every share still owed: bold name, "$3 extension · Thu, Nov 12", Mark paid (Confirm
   after an I paid), Request / Text / "no Venmo saved", Remind; Undo on the toast. A debt stays until paid, however old (the lookback read now also keeps games
   with a share owed, in the same one read).
5. Player alerts (text only, no title, X): amber "You owe **$3** for the extra 30 min we added to yesterday's game. It'll be added to your next game." with
   "Pay now instead"; two or more games: ONE alert with the total ("for extra time on past games"); credit used: the blue credit card (the site's credit color)
   "Your **$3** credit was used for ..." or "**$2** of your credit was used for ... You owe $1 more, added to your next game." "tonight's game" (same evening),
   "yesterday's game" (next day), else "the Nov 10 game". The X closes it for good (saved on the seat, so every phone); it cancels no debt; a new or changed
   share brings it back.
6. History: Activity lines for the game ("Alex added 30 min of extra time for Thu, Nov 12: $12 court, 3 pay $3 each, you cover $3") and for every share that moved
   ("Blair's extra time share went from $6 to $3 for Thu, Nov 12, $3 back as credit"); the player's credit sheet ("$3 used for extra time on Nov 12",
   "$1 back from Nov 12 (extra time changed)").

### Totals (server/money.ts)
- Court costs: + the extra court cost of every played game. Collected ("Players paid"): + what players put toward their shares once it is real money (credit used,
  or cash Alex confirmed; an I paid not yet confirmed is Held). Your cost follows (court + membership - collected), so it rises by exactly Alex's part.
- Example (4 played, 2 hours, $48 court, all paid $14, +30 min): before Court costs $48, Collected $42, your court part $6. After Finalize: Court costs $60,
  Collected $42 (nobody has paid the extension yet), your court part $18. Once the three $3 shares are paid: Collected $51, your court part $9 (your $3).

## Zip 33: Games index (🎾33.index), Wed Nov 11, 2026
Status: built and tested on fake data. NOT applied to the preview database, NOT deployed. Waiting for Alex's "ship it". Database change: quiet window only, and after 🎾31's 0019 is on main.
No screen, money rule, price, credit rule, Telegram message or cost changed. Only `migrations/0020_games_index.sql` (three indexes) and tests were added.

### What was slow, in plain words
Every open screen asks "anything new?" every 5 seconds, and the Home screens and the 5-minute clock ask more. Two things made them read far more than needed, and both grow every week:
1. The lookups for "games not ended yet" (or ended in the last 90 days) read every game ever made. No index on a game's end time.
2. Every "is this feature switch on?" question reads ALL `mark` rows of `task_log`. Switch rows and per-game marks (court_booked, played, price_lock: about 3 per finished game) live in the same table, so with Fewer database trips ON (as on live) the shared switch read, the animation setting and the hidden-games read each read every mark. This was the biggest growth, bigger than the games table.

### Measured (real D1 engine, locally: wrangler's workerd; the `rows_read` number D1 bills; every request's real statements, run by the real site code)
Fake group shaped like live (10 players, switches ON as on live, about 3 marks and 6 to 8 sign-ups per old game), today 15 games, plus 35, 50, 100 and 500 games. Rows read per call, before -> after:

| call | 15 games (today) | 35 | 50 | 100 | 500 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| player 5-second check | 308 -> 250 | 589 -> 351 | 771 -> 356 | 1371 -> 356 | 6171 -> 356 |
| player Home load | 798 -> 680 | 1599 -> 1181 | 2059 -> 1346 | 3559 -> 1846 | 15559 -> 5846 |
| organizer 5-second check | 312 -> 317 | 832 -> 797 | 1014 -> 907 | 1564 -> 1207 | 5965 -> 3608 |
| organizer Home load | 1590 -> 1458 | 4109 -> 3597 | 5659 -> 4792 | 10759 -> 8692 | 51560 -> 39893 |
| Money tab | 325 -> 264 | 446 -> 265 | 536 -> 265 | 836 -> 265 | 3236 -> 265 |
| History tab | 219 -> 209 | 279 -> 209 | 324 -> 209 | 474 -> 209 | 1674 -> 209 |
| 5-minute clock tick | 69 -> 64 | 209 -> 64 | 314 -> 64 | 664 -> 64 | 3464 -> 64 |

The player 5-second check (the busiest call) becomes flat. Real D1, preview database, BEFORE only (read-only, 65 games): games in window 65, sign-ups 274 and 87, all switch rows 43, animation setting 42, hidden games 42, organizer marks 84, tick games 65 rows. After numbers need 0020 applied to `pickleball-preview` (not done yet).

### What is NOT fixed by indexes (needs a code change; NOT done, for Alex to decide)
- Organizer Home still grows: lifetime "games played" count per player (reads every past sign-up), "oldest unpaid game" lookback (every game older than 90 days, from about Feb 2027), the id/date list of every game (credit history labels), late-drop counts (a small partial index on `session_players (session_id) WHERE late_drop_at IS NOT NULL` fixes it: held back because the brief caps this zip at three indexes; 500 games: 4425 rows saved per organizer Home), the organizer 5-second check's `task_log` marks read (all marks, part of the fingerprint). These touch money screens or the fingerprint, so no rewrite was done.

`tests/games-index.test.ts` (6 tests): the file holds three CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS and nothing else, runs twice, adds exactly the three names, row counts equal, the lookups use the new indexes (and did not before), every player and organizer answer (5-second checks, Home, Money, History, three players) holds the same JSON values with and without the indexes, and the DROP statements in the file bring the old plans back with the same answers. One field, `gameMonthCounts` (an object built from a query with no ORDER BY), lists its months in a different key order on the migrated database; the Money month list is rebuilt from the keys (`monthChoices` sorts), so the order is never read. Fresh reviewer: all plan changes checked on 238 statement shapes from about 77 test files, no changed result; found only that 10 older tests pinned 0018 as the newest migration (fixed: they look at the newest up to 0018).

Today's code runs on the migrated database unchanged (indexes are invisible to old code; every test in the suite runs it that way), so a code rollback needs NO database step. Statements, each instant, no data touched:

DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_sessions_group_ends;
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_task_log_switch_rows;

## Zip 35: Cleanup (🎾35.cleanup), Wed Nov 11, 2026
Status: built and tested on fake data. Preview only. NOT merged, NOT deployed to live. Waiting for Alex's "ship it". ### Part A: Second Chance past closing (audit A-11), live-on bug fix, no switch
- The bug (reproduced first, `tests/second-chance-hours.test.ts` "REPRODUCED ON MAIN"): Second Chance offers start times from 4:00 PM to 9:30 PM. With Booking hours ON and a 2 hour game, 8:30 PM and later END after the 10:00 PM closing (7:00 PM closing on Sunday). Tapping one reopened the game (credit that had come back from the cancel turned into "owes" again, the cancel's price lock was dropped), and only THEN did the time change get refused, leaving the game reopened at its old time with an error on screen.
- The fix (`server/secondChance.ts`, `shared/secondChance.ts`, `src/pages/admin/SecondChance.tsx`), only while Booking hours is ON for the request:
  1. The picker offers only starts whose END also fits the hours of the game's date (`pickTimes(..., { lengthMs })`, using `lengthFits` from `shared/bookingHours.ts`). A 2 hour game: nothing after 8:00 PM Monday to Saturday, nothing after 5:00 PM on Sunday. The game's own time is offered only if it fits.
  2. If no time fits, the card says "No time fits inside the venue hours for a game this long. Nothing was reopened." (Reopen game is disabled) and the server answers 409 `no_time_fits` and changes nothing.
  3. The server checks the picked time (hours, in the future) BEFORE touching the game. A refused pick leaves the game canceled, nothing moved, no mark, no money change (tested: seats, credit ledger, pots, marks all identical).
  4. The time move now happens FIRST, while the game is still canceled (one all-or-nothing save; `reschedule` got an optional third parameter `whileCanceled` that only Second Chance passes; the Edit game route is unchanged), then the mark, then the reopen. If the reopen itself fails, the original time is put back and the mark removed (tested with a database trigger that refuses the reopen).
- Booking hours OFF: the old order and the old list (4:00 to 9:30 PM), byte for byte. The one difference is one extra read of the switch row on a Second Chance tap. Failures that have nothing to do with hours (a clash with another game at that exact moment, a past time on a preview) behave as on main with the switch off; they are only fixed with Booking hours on.
- Money check: nothing in the reopen's money code was touched. `decide({decision:'reopen'})` is called exactly as before; a successful reopen+move leaves the same seats, credit and price as main (the existing `tests/second-chance.test.ts` money flow passes unchanged: 27 tests). The move-first order changes only the Activity log order (the "moved" line comes before the "reopened" line).
- Tests: `tests/second-chance-hours.test.ts` (17) and `e2e/zip35.cjs` A1 to A3 (picker with hours on and off, a refused 9:00 PM leaves the game canceled, 7:00 PM reopens and moves it, the card and the no-fit message fit at 390/360/320, light and dark, text 100% and 150%).

### Part B: Tap guard fix (TAP_GUARD_FIX, ships OFF)
- The problem: the page's fast-tap guard (src/InstantTaps.tsx, only while Instant taps is on) stops any click within 400 ms and 24 px of the click before it on a DIFFERENT button. That is meant for the second half of a double tap landing on whatever slid under the finger, but it also drops a real quick tap on a neighbouring button: "Hide it" sits about 23 px from "Hide from list". (e2e/money-rework.cjs already waits 450 ms for this reason.)
- With the switch ON the guard drops: (a) a repeat tap on the SAME element within the window, and (b) a tap on ANOTHER button within the window when the button tapped before has been removed from the page or has moved 6 px or more (the card was replaced, the row slid, the page scrolled), or when it comes within 0.2 s of the last tap (added after the fresh review: a double tap on Pay opens the Pay sheet under the finger and its second half could land on I paid; nobody aims at a new button that fast). A neighbour that stayed where it was and is tapped after 0.2 s goes through. Known: with the switch ON a deliberate fast repeat on the SAME button (for example Previous month twice to jump two months) loses its second tap if it comes within 0.4 s and 24 px; with the switch OFF it never did. A label and the switch the browser clicks for it count as ONE tap (found by the browser test: without this, the fix would have blocked every Settings switch). Text boxes and menus are never dropped. OFF: the old expression, word for word, and no measuring.
- Beyond Alex's wording: he asked for "only a repeat tap on the SAME button". The literal version would have lost the protection that matters most (a double tap on I paid or Mark paid whose first tap replaces the button: the second tap would then pay the next person). Rule (b) keeps that. Asked of Alex in the report.
- Wiring (same as the other switches): `shared/tapGuard.ts` (the rule as a plain function, `dropThisTap`), `server/tapGuardFix.ts`, `PUT /api/admin/tap-guard-switch`, Settings > Feature switches > "Tap guard fix" (top row), private link `?tapguard=on` (any page, header `X-Tap-Guard-Fix`), kill switch `TAP_GUARD_FIX` in `[vars]` and `[env.preview.vars]`, History lines, the flag on the player Home answer (`tapGuardFix`) and the organizer dashboard (`tapGuardFix`, `tapGuardFixForAll`), `docs/FEATURE_SWITCHES.md`. The switch question rides on the shared switch read (`server/speed.ts`), so it adds no database trip with Fewer trips on (as on live).

### Part D: Test runner, tooling only
- `npm run test:e2e` is now `node e2e/all.cjs` (list in `e2e/suite.cjs`, 68 scripts, was a one-line `&&` chain of 65 that stopped at the first failure). It runs every script even after a failure, 3 at a time (`--lanes=N`, at most 4), each with its own `E2E_PORT` (base 5600, 2 apart) and its own process group (killed when the script ends or times out after 20 minutes, so no leftover server holds a port), prints ONE summary (script, PASS or FAIL, passed, failed, seconds), then runs the failures again ALONE one at a time ("PASS (on rerun)" is called out as a busy machine, not a bug), and exits 0 only when everything is green. Per-script output is in `.data/e2e-logs/<name>.log`. `--only` is just the script names: `npm run test:e2e -- zip35 double-tap`. `--list`, `--no-rerun`, `--timeout=MIN`, `--base-port=N` exist.

## Zip 39: money fixes (🎾39.moneyfix, CHEAPER_FIX ships OFF) - built Thu Nov 12, 2026 (night); NOT deployed
Branch `claude/new-session-iu01w9` (the brief's name "🎾39.moneyfix" is the session name). Built on main `60b446d`. No schema change, no migration, no new cost, no new text. One new switch, "Made cheaper after paying" (`CHEAPER_FIX`), ships OFF; the only screen change is its Settings row.

### What changed
1. Made cheaper after paying (switch ON only). A game whose price went DOWN after a player paid (made 1.5 hours with Short games on, or Booking hours turned off on a 2.5 or 3 hour game) and then a late fee kept on it. Before: the seat kept everything it paid (Zip 9 known gap b, the Zip 27 A-02 note "a price LOWERED after a cash payment and then a late fee keeps the higher payment"). Now the seat keeps exactly the fee and the rest comes back as credit at the same three moments where Zip 27 A-02 asks for the gap the other way:
   - late cancel with the fee kept, no split (`server/admin.ts` `cancelFeeKept` + `cheaperCancelPlan`): the split's own seat moves (`splitSeatStatements`) at the fee, and, like the split, the cancel only goes ahead if no seat or credit changed since it was read. "$3 back from Nov 10 (canceled)". The split (5 or more in) already did this.
   - late drop that leaves the game short (`server/roster.ts` `withdraw` + `cheaperDropStatements`): "(dropped)". A sub later gives back the fee left on the seat, as before.
   - no-show at Finalize with fewer than 4 played (`server/finalize.ts`): given back the way a played seat's extra is ('finalized', the payment stays as paid), so Reopen and Unmark take it back. `clearLateFee` (no-show) now gives back only what is left (a no-op for every seat that has no such credit, i.e. every seat on main).
   - Already right on main, on or off, and unchanged: a PLAYED seat gets the extra back at Finalize; a Reopen and redo reprices.
2. Double Finalize: NOT a bug, no code change. Proof in `tests/zip39-money.test.ts`: (a) three Finalize taps at once at the same millisecond leave exactly what one Finalize leaves (seats, every ledger row, pots, Activity counts, the price lock, Totals), 5 played and 3 played (no-show), switch on and off; (b) the worst case, the whole Finalize step run a second time from the same old read at the same millisecond (so its "this batch finalized the game" check reads true): the second answers 409 already_finalized and moves nothing. Every money statement in the batch also guards itself (a part-back entry only if none exists, a settle only on an unsettled seat, a hold only on the payment as read, pay-with-credit only on an unpaid seat). `tests/dryrun-money.test.ts` already had "double taps never double charge or double credit" (two Everyone played taps, all cash).
3. A-18 (switch ON only): a new Price per player reprices the seats of open games (`updateGroup`), the way the Short games and Booking hours rows already do. `tests/ledger-fuzz.test.ts` G stays `it.fails` (it runs with the switch off).
4. Found while testing (no switch, every game): `splitSeatStatements` (the fee split's seat moves, now shared) re-inserted "the credit that stays on the seat" and a re-held cash pair from an EXISTS check that a second run at the same millisecond also passes. Both inserts now also need "no such live row on the seat yet". A single run is unchanged (that run has just ended those rows). Proof: the run-twice test fails without the guard and passes with it.

## Zip 38: Christmas skin (🎾38.xmas, CHRISTMAS_SKIN ships OFF) - built Fri Nov 13, 2026; on a preview, NOT deployed to live
Branch `claude/new-session-oxmi5e` (the brief's name "🎾38.xmas" is the session name; this environment fixes the branch name). Built on main `f73a557`. No schema change, no migration, no money, no new cost, no new words except the two small bubbles. One new switch, "Christmas skin" (`CHRISTMAS_SKIN`), ships OFF. Alex's locked look and motion are in the brief (START_HERE of the zip); the approved pictures are what `e2e/zip38.cjs` was written against.

### What it is, in plain words
A look-only Christmas theme for the PLAYER screens. Two layers:
- **The window** (`shared/christmasSkin.ts`, computed each year, no yearly edit): the Friday after US Thanksgiving through Dec 31, Eastern (2026: Fri Nov 27 to Thu Dec 31; 2027: Fri Nov 26). The server answers ONE flag (`christmasSkin`) only when the Settings row is on for the phone AND today is inside the window. Outside the window, or with the row off, the answer carries no flag and nothing is read from the database about it (the date is checked first): player answers, pages and pictures are today's byte for byte (`e2e/zip38-off.cjs`, three ways, below). Inside the window the Christmas logo (`public/logo-xmas.png`, inside the usual square outline, the page's own color behind it) replaces the normal logo and STAYS, theme on or off.
- **The theme** starts OFF on every phone. Tapping the logo toggles it, remembered per phone (`pb_xmas_theme`). First visit only: bubble "Tap for Christmas theme" (about 2 s or any tap, never again, `pb_xmas_hint`). Each tap ON shows "Tap to switch back" (about 2 s, no toast); this reading of the brief is in QUESTIONS (it could be limited to the first ON tap).

### Built inside React, not injected (the prototype's problem)
`src/skin/store.ts` (one small store: available, on, motion phase, bubble; set only by the player Home screen and cleared when it unmounts, so no admin screen ever sees it), `src/skin/theme.tsx` (the SLOTS: logo, seat marker, toast/burst badge; a second theme fills the same slots), `src/skin/christmas.css` (every rule under `html[data-skin='christmas']`, plus the logo button and bubbles), `src/skin/SkinLogo.tsx`, `src/skin/useSkinRoot.ts`. `SpotDots` (src/ui.tsx) draws ornaments when the theme is on (so every game card and alert card follows), the Game on toast and the burst use the theme badge, `TopBar` takes an optional `skinLogo`, `ScheduleRow` gets `top` (cap and first-card jingle). Colors, sizes and timings were taken from `prototype/xmas-skin.js` and its keyframes. Dark tokens used (cane white #d9d2c8, red #e0453f, lighter empty ring).

## Zip 43: Venue charge alert (built Fri Nov 13, 2026, ships OFF; not merged, not deployed)

- Admin only, display only, no database schema change, no money moves. New switch `VENUE_ALERT` ("Venue charge alert"), OFF by default; private link `/admin?venuealert=on` (`=off` ends it). NO `wrangler.toml` variable: Cloudflare's free plan allows 64 variables (secrets + text) per site and the preview was already at 64, so a 65th made `npm run deploy:preview` fail ("65 variables"); its kill switch is the Settings row (the code would still obey `VENUE_ALERT = "off"` if one were set). Heads up for every later zip: no more new `wrangler.toml` variables on previews until some are removed. Documented in `docs/FEATURE_SWITCHES.md`.
- What it does: on the venue's charge days an amber card sits at the very top of organizer Home (it counts in the Home badge): courts "Northville Pickleball should have charged you $96 / 2 games x $48 = $96", membership "Membership should have been charged: $30 / Monthly membership, Northville Pickleball", or one combined card when both land on one day. ONE button, Mark paid (no Dismiss): one History line "Venue charge marked paid: $96", and the card goes. A card stays until Mark paid, also if the day was missed.
- Settings > Money, right under Monthly membership (hidden with the switch off): "Membership charged on" (1st to 31st, default 26th, a day past a short month's end means its last day) and "Court costs charged on" (1st to 28th or Last day, default Last day). Normal dropdowns, each saves the moment it changes.
- Storage (no schema change): the two days inside the group's `settings_json` (`venueDays`, next to the Zelle number; every Settings save keeps them, a save that never touched them adds nothing); the switch row and one `task_log` row per month marked paid (`venue_paid:court:2026-11`, kind mark, no game), exactly how the other switches are stored. Backups skip `task_log`, like every other switch row, so a restore turns the switch off and forgets marked-paid months.
- The math: games in the billing period (the day after last month's court charge day through this one, Eastern dates) whose court status is Booked and that are not canceled, each at its own court cost else the Typical court cost (the same `courtCostOf` Money > Totals uses). Costs that differ read "N games = $X". Midnight is Eastern, not UTC.
- No backfill: a charge day makes a card only if its 12:00 AM Eastern is at or after the later of (a) the moment the switch went on (the Settings row's own time; for the private link the moment that phone first opened it) and (b) the moment a charge day was last CHANGED. A second "on" while it is already on changes nothing. A moved court day also never bills a game an earlier, marked-paid court charge already covered (period start is bounded by it).
- Known differences from Money > Totals, written down: Totals counts a game once it is finalized and adds Zip 31 extra-time cost; the alert counts every Booked, not canceled game in the period (the venue charges it) and not the extra time, so the two agree for a month where every booked game was finalized and the alert can be higher before Finalize. Games hidden from the lists still count (the venue still charges them). Sample (preview, last month): 2 booked games x $48 = $96 on the card and Courts $96 on Money > Totals, agree.
- Preview: switch row ON and back-dated to the 1st of last month (so last month's two charge days are "after" it); calm profile keeps last month's two booked games (hidden from the lists) so the court card reads "2 games x $48 = $96". See docs/PREVIEW_FAKE_DB.md.
- Fresh reviewer (a separate agent, only the diff and the rules): three real findings, all fixed with tests: a changed charge day could bring back an already-passed day (now the days-changed time is a second no-backfill floor), a repeated switch-on moved the start forward and hid an unpaid card (now does nothing), a $0 membership made a pointless card (now no card). Also found and handled: a moved court day re-billing games an earlier paid charge covered. Left as written: switching on at 9 AM on a charge day makes no card for that day (the day began before the switch); a card also vanishes when its day is moved to a day already past.

## Zip 42: Guest spot (🎾42.guest, GUEST_SPOT, ships OFF) - built Fri Nov 13, 2026
Branch `claude/new-session-v00cxc` (the brief's name "🎾42.guest" is the session name), built on main `44293be`. MOVES MONEY AND SEATS. One database change,
migration `0021_guest_spot` (four nullable columns on `session_players`), applied to `pickleball-preview` ONLY. NOT run on live, NOT deployed.

### Design
A guest is not a player record. It is four columns on the HOST's own seat row: `guest_name`, `guest_status` ('confirmed', 'waitlisted', or 'late' while it is
part of the host's open late-drop debt), `guest_seq` (its place in the join order), `guest_at`. So the guest's $14 is the host's seat money: every payment,
credit entry, refund and late fee is the host's by construction, and the credit ledger never names a guest. A seat with its guest in counts as 2 people
(`seatUnits`, shared/guestSpot.ts): priced at two shares, and every count of who is in adds the guests (`headCount`, `waitQueue`). No guest: units 1, so a
game without a guest reads exactly as before. SQL only names the new columns once the migration ran (`hasGuestColumns`, cached per database).

### Rules as built (shared/guestSpot.ts)
- Add (organizer, switch on): Players sheet > three dots > Add a guest, first name only (letters, 1 to 20). Room and the host in: the guest is in; else waits
  behind the host (Card cleanup on: a full game refuses). A host who paid $14 is held at $14 and owes $14 more. Refused while the host has an unconfirmed I paid.
  A guest taking a spot clears the oldest open late-drop debt like any sub.
- Remove (host from the card with the switch on, organizer always): paid $28 gives $14 back as credit; unpaid owes $14 less; the spot goes to the first waiter.
  The organizer gets one Telegram when a HOST removes a guest.
- Drop out: the guest goes too. Inside the 12 hours with the game left short, the debt is two shares; the first sub takes the guest's spot ($14 off or back),
  the second the host's. Organizer Remove of the host takes both.
- Finalize: the guest played when the host did (one switch for the pair); N counts the guest; the host's due is two final prices.
- Late cancel with the fee kept: the pair owes two shares; with the split on, N counts the guest.
- Names: "Rowan + Sam (guest)" on player cards, organizer cards, folded rows, Who played, History. Texts carry counts and amounts, not names.

## Zip 45: free up Cloudflare variables (🎾45.variables), Sat Nov 14, 2026
Branch `claude/new-session-86rg5b`. No database change, no money change, no code change: only `wrangler.toml`, tests and docs. Plain-English summary for Alex is in the report; this is the record.

### Why
Cloudflare's free plan allows 64 variables per Pages project (secrets included). Production had 58 (53 plain + 5 secrets), the preview 60 (59 plain + 1 secret), so Zips 42 and 43 had to ship their switches with no variable. Almost every plain variable was `"on"` for an "allowed unless off" kill switch, where the code reads a missing value exactly like `"on"` (`(value ?? 'on').trim().toLowerCase() !== 'off'`).

'').trim().toLowerCase() === 'on'`: missing = off). No variable was set to `"off"`, so nothing of that kind existed to keep. Secrets were not touched (they are not in `wrangler.toml`).

Cannot sit behind a Settings switch (which files a phone downloads is fixed at build time), so the safety is the tests below; `docs/FEATURE_SWITCHES.md` "Not switched (Zip 48)".

### What changed
- `src/main.tsx`: `/admin` opens through `src/pages/AdminRoute.tsx`, which fetches `src/pages/AdminEntry.tsx` (Admin.tsx and everything under `src/pages/admin/`) on demand (`src/adminChunk.ts`). On `/admin` the first draw waits up to 1.5 s for that file, so a phone that has it draws Admin (or the Instant admin copy) straight away with no loading step. Every other address draws at once.
- `vite.config.ts` (`adminPage`): the build writes `dist/admin.html` = the page plus three lines that start the organizer files at once, side by side with the main file, the organizer style file after the main one. Cloudflare Pages serves it for `/admin` (checked on the preview: `/admin` and `/admin?…` 200; `/admin/` now 308 to `/admin` with the `?…` kept, it used to answer 200 directly; `/admin.html` 308 to `/admin`; a missing `/assets/` file 404).
- The organizer's loading screen moved unchanged to `src/pages/AdminLoading.tsx` (player download), so the file step and the data step show the same screen; the shimmer carries over between them instead of hiding for 250 ms again.
- Organizer's phone: `src/organizerPhone.ts` (localStorage `pb_organizer_phone` = "1", set when the dashboard answers, cleared on sign out or a "sign in again" answer). Its player screen fetches the organizer file quietly 3 s after drawing (also when the server says `goToAdmin`), never in View as, never on Data Saver, never for a player.
- Recovery (`src/adminRecover.ts`, `src/adminChunk.ts`): a failed fetch asks the site (HEAD `/`, no-store). Site answers (an old page after a deploy): reload once, written down in sessionStorage first; a second failure within a minute, or storage blocked, shows Try again instead (no loop). No answer: Try again ("No connection right now…"), and it tries by itself on the phone's `online` event. Still loading after 15 s: Try again ("taking a long time"), the fetch keeps going and draws Admin when it lands. A style file that failed (error event, no sheet, unreadable or empty sheet) is fetched again in the same place before Admin draws (Vite's own loader never retries one).
- Style order: the organizer style file now loads after the player style file. To keep /admin rule for rule as before: `src/admin-late.css` repeats the late player style files (large-text through the Christmas skin, not alert-cards.css which the player code loads early) at the end of the organizer file; `src/do-now-admin.css` keeps do-now.css at its old place inside the organizer styles; an earlier exact twin of a rule can never win over the later one. The player's credit list (CREDIT chip sheet) was styled by a block in the organizer file `src/credit-admin.css`: an exact copy is in `src/credit-history.css` in the player download, at the organizer styles' old place (`src/main.tsx`, above `src/adminSlot.ts`). Every other organizer-only rule matches nothing on a player screen (checked in the browser on every player scene; the `:root` rules only set `--tok-*` and `--bh-*` colors no player rule reads).

## Zip 49: money fixes from Audit C (🎾49.moneyfix), Sun Nov 15, 2026
Branch `claude/new-session-r7eh7b` (the session is named "🎾49.moneyfix"; the build system pins the branch name). Built on main `b8ba448`. MOVES MONEY.
No schema change, no new Cloudflare variable, no new switch: Late fees and Guest spot stay as Alex set them (both ON on live). Findings and
reproductions: docs/audits/AUDIT_C_2026-11.md on branch `claude/new-session-am79iy` (PR #137, not merged).

### The rule behind items 1, 7 and 8 (Alex)
A late drop owes only the spots the game is short of 4 (organizer counted), at most 2 for a host and guest. What is charged, what is shown and
what is kept always agree.

### What changed
1. M-1 (must-fix). A seat that holds whole guest shares it no longer owes gives them back as credit the moment the money is real:
   - Alex confirms an I paid (`fitConfirmedClaim`, server/admin.ts): on an open late drop or no-show, or a seat in a game that is on;
   - the host rejoins alone after a late pair drop (`trimRejoined`, server/roster.ts): $14 back at once (it used to wait for Finalize);
   - any one-share late drop (server/roster.ts withdraw, after the pair trim);
   - Finalize, for an open late-drop seat, as a safety net (server/finalize.ts).
   The trim only moves WHOLE $14 shares (`wholeSharesOf`, server/guestSpot.ts `trimGuestShares`), so a game made cheaper after paying stays
   "Made cheaper after paying"'s job, switch and all. An unconfirmed I paid never moves by itself.
2. F-2. `gamePriceCents` (src/pages/admin/moneyRework.ts) counts a host-with-guest row as two people at half its price: Text all asks for $14.
   The host's own reminder still says $28.
3. F-3. History and notices say the real amount: `late_fee_owed` stores $28 for a pair (`priceCents`), `late_fee_cleared` stores `debtCents`
   (pair $28, split $11); the "You no longer owe" notice uses it; a sub who took only the guest's spot says "someone took Sam's spot ... You no
   longer owe $14 for Sam"; part credit on an unpaid seat reads "You owe $11" in the dialog, toast and server answer; a paid pair two short reads
   "Your $28 stays"; Remove guest's money back reads "(guest removed)". Old History lines (no stored amount) read exactly as before.
4. F-4. Confirming an I paid below the seat's price (I paid $14, then the guest moved in) holds the $14 as cash: the seat owes $14. Before the
   confirm the host's card reads "Paid $14" with "$14 due" (`claimCents`), Sam's row reads unpaid and the paid count is 1 of 2.
5. F-6. The organizer's Give spot (Players sheet) runs the normal move-ins, so a guest left waiting behind the host moves in when there is room.
6. F-21. Guest names: one spelling (NFC), at most 2 accent marks on a letter, a first letter whose capital is two letters ("ß") stays as typed
   (never past 20). Emoji, markup, digits, invisible characters and 21+ letters were already refused.
7. No-show pair (Alex). Host and guest both "did not play" with fewer than 4 played: the host owes $14 x the spots short (1 short $14, 2 or more
   $28). Finalize marks the guest's share out (`guest_played` 0, which Reopen clears); a paid $28 gets $14 back. Who played note: "Blair didn't
   play, so Sam didn't either. Blair owes $14, for the 1 spot the game was short."
8. Moved game (Alex). Edit game to another day clears every open late-drop debt (money back as credit, History "Blair's $14 late drop cleared
   (game moved to another day)") and takes off a guest spot owed after a late removal. A time change on the same day changes nothing.
9. F-1. Venue alert: each court card's period only starts after a paid court charge EARLIER than its own charge day (`courtPaidDates`), so
   marking November paid leaves October's card until its own Mark paid.

### Left alone (Alex)
Daylight saving cancel-by on clock-change Sundays; M-2 (backup format) has its own zip. Not in this zip (F-7 is item 7, F-8 is item 8): F-5, F-9,
F-10 to F-20, F-22 to F-24. Known small one: the player's credit sheet line for Remove guest still reads "(you dropped)" (it comes from the credit
entry's stored reason, which other money code reads; changing it is not a wording-only change).

### Fresh reviewer (did not write the code)
Two real bugs, both fixed: (1) Text all asked for $7 after a one-share no-show pair (the guest view now carries `units`, the seat's people count);
(2) Unmark after a trim left the trimmed $14 as credit from nothing (also true before this zip for Remove guest and the round 3 one-short drop):
Unmark now takes back 'dropped' credit made after the seat's payment while the seat is still paid (`undoTrimBackStatements`), or refuses when it
was spent. Also fixed: the "Paid $14 · $14 due" card and the confirm's cash hold apply only to a seat whose price went up because of its guest (a
single player reads exactly as before); the confirm's follow-up step is guarded against a Finalize or Reopen at the same moment; Finalize gives a
one-share no-show pair back only whole $14 shares; the Who played note never says the organizer owes. Left, display only: a Reopen after a confirm
that came after Finalize can read Paid at $14 on a $28 seat until the redo (the redo settles it); the moved-game notice names the new date.

## Zip 50: protect ourselves (🎾50.protect), Sun Nov 15, 2026
Branch `claude/new-session-c2gwa5` (the session is named "🎾50.protect"; the build system pins the branch name). Built on main `96caa6f`
(Zips 48 and 49 live). No schema change, no new Cloudflare variable, no new switch, nothing a player sees changes. The Audit C doc
(`docs/audits/AUDIT_C_2026-11.md`, PR #137) and its probes and `tests/dst-2027.test.ts` are merged in with this zip.

### 1. Backups hold everything (Audit C M-2, F-13)
- The backup file (Settings > Backup) and the weekly copy are now **file version 2**: `server/backupData.ts` BACKUP_TABLES adds `task_log`
  (every Feature switch, the price locks, venue months marked paid, the Christmas choice, hidden games, "Do this now" taps, "already sent"
  marks), `organizer_alerts` (Settings > Alerts) and `admin_sessions` (organizer sign-ins, hashes only). Still left out on purpose:
  `login_attempts`, `rate_events` (short-lived counters).
- Reader (`scripts/backup-sql.mjs`): takes version 1 and 2. A version 1 file restores exactly as before (the three come back empty,
  even if something put rows in them); a version 2 file missing one is refused; an unknown version is refused with a plain message.
  The restore now clears every table children first (the three included), instead of relying on the cascade.
- The read-only PIN's download also blanks `admin_sessions` (plus the PIN hash, group word and phone codes as before).
- The weekly copy (`worker/backup.ts`) writes the same version 2 file in its steps: the clock Worker must be deployed with the site.
- View as (`src/demo/sandbox.ts`) loads the new file as is (its task_log copy uses INSERT OR IGNORE, so nothing doubles).
- Restore test (`scripts/restore-test-lib.ts`): the switch-row workaround and its NOTE only for version 1 files; new FAIL lines for a
  backup column this checkout lacks (F-22) and for a read-only download (F-11).
- Restore script (`scripts/restore-backup.mjs`): refuses a read-only download (F-11); a file from before Oct 29 no longer errors after
  writing the SQL (F-12, Audit A-21); the summary line names the file version and warns about an old one.
- Proof: `tests/zip50-backup.test.ts` (12 tests). Fake world with 11 price locks, then every price rule changed, the Christmas choice,
  a hidden game, three Settings > Alerts rows off and a venue month marked paid. Download and weekly copy (one run and in steps) are the
  same file; each restored with the real script into an EMPTY database gives every row of all 13 tables, every switch row, every price
  lock, Settings > Alerts, the venue cards, the Christmas choice, the hidden game and every money number on the organizer's and players'
  screens back unchanged: October court cost $408 before and after. Restoring over changed data puts the file back exactly. An old
  version 1 file still restores (and shows the old loss: $386).
- Docs: docs/RESTORE.md rewritten as one plan for a non-developer (the ways back, Plan A Time Travel with the bookmarks, Plan B a
  file or weekly copy, what to do with an old file); audit section 6 points to it; RESTORE_TEST.md, DEPLOY.md, RUNBOOK_TUESDAY.md fixed.
- Weekly copies made before this deploy stay version 1 until the first Sunday copy after it (Nov 22).

### 2. Change PIN guess limit (Audit C F-5)
- `server/auth.ts` `checkCurrentPinCounted`, called by Change PIN: each guess is written down first in `login_attempts` under the key
  `pin-change:` + a hash of that phone's sign-in, then counted: 5 wrong current PINs within any 15 minutes (a rolling window, the same
  rule sign-in uses), then 429 "Too many wrong PINs.
  Wait 15 minutes and try again." without checking the PIN (a refused try is not counted, so it never makes the wait longer). A right PIN
  clears the count. Sign-in's own counts skip these keys, so Change PIN can never lock anyone out of signing in or of the organizer
  screens; other signed-in phones have their own count.
- Tests: `tests/zip50-pin-limit.test.ts` (9): guesses 1 to 5 checked, the 6th refused even with the right PIN, the wait ending at 15
  minutes, the count starting over, screens and sign-in working during the wait, 25 wrong Change PIN guesses not touching sign-in, a burst.

### 3. Zelle number out of the public code (Audit C F-19, A-30)
- Where it was: the built-in default in `shared/settings.ts` (`DEFAULT_ZELLE_NUMBER`), which shipped in the player download; also in
  `tests/pay-sheet.test.ts`, `e2e/pay-sheet.cjs`, docs/FEATURE_SWITCHES.md and this file. All gone from the current files (git history
  not rewritten: Alex decides).
- Now: the number lives only in the group's settings (Settings > Money, `zelleNumber` in `settings_json`). Nothing saved = no number
  shown. Live had nothing saved (read Sun Nov 15), so the deploy step saves the same number into live's settings first, then the code
  goes out: players see the same Pay sheet. Previews get a fake one from the seed.

### 4. Other security items (Audit C)
- F-10 (Audit A-09) fixed: a phone that signed in with the real PIN carries a "known organizer phone" cookie (`pb_known_org`: a random
  value plus a fingerprint made with the stored PIN hash; no database row, no variable). It skips only the OVERALL wrong-PIN cap (20 in 15
  minutes), never its own cap of 5 or the PIN. A PIN change ends every old mark. Never set by the read-only PIN. `tests/zip50-signin.test.ts`.
- Skipped: F-17 (names holding a web address): refusing them changes what a player sees when typing a name, and the Telegram app makes
  addresses tappable on its own. F-18 (group word overall cap): a cap there would let a stranger lock real players out of typing the
  word (the same trade-off as F-10). F-20 ("Acting for others" trusts any organizer cookie): the fix needs a database read on every
  player tap and about ten call sites, for a flag that never touches money.

## Zip 51: the last three money edge cases from Audit C (🎾51.edgecases), Mon Nov 16, 2026
Branch `claude/new-session-uyfl03` (the session is named "🎾51.edgecases"; the build system pins the branch name). Built on main `552cbd2`
(Zips 48, 49 and 50 live). MOVES MONEY (F-15, F-16) and changes the organizer's venue cards (F-9). No schema change, no new Cloudflare variable,
no new switch. The only new words are F-16's "This just changed." in the Drop out dialog.

### 1. F-9: the Venue charge alert never skips or hides a charge day (shared/venueAlert.ts)
- What was wrong: a moved charge day started the "no backfill" clock over, so every card already due vanished at the move, and a court day
  moved after a paid month left games on no card (court 15th, Nov 15 paid, moved to Last day: Nov 16 to 30 never billed; moved to the 20th after
  Oct 15 was paid: Oct 16 to 20 never billed). A membership day moved past itself (28th back to the 26th on the 27th) skipped the month.
- Now, charge days on a timeline: the Settings save that moves a day writes the old days down with when they were in force
  (`venueDays.history` in the group's settings_json, at most 24 entries, no schema change). A day counts when the days in force at its
  12:00 AM name it; before the switch went on, the days in force at that moment decide (days picked while turning the switch on are a correction,
  not a move). A month left with no day gets the current days' day, so no month is skipped.
- Court periods chain: each card's games run from the day after the court charge day before it (paid or not) to its own day, so every booked
  game is on exactly one card, and Mark paid on one card never changes another. A second court charge in one month is its own card, keyed by its
  date (`court:2026-11-30`, task `venue_paid:court:2026-11-30`); the usual one keeps the month key, so older rows read as before.
- No-backfill now starts only when the switch went on (a moved day no longer restarts it). A move saved before this release kept no old days:
  the current days count for that time, as the site always assumed.
- Tests: tests/zip51-edgecases.test.ts (12 for F-9, exact amounts: the two moves above through the real server, a move to a day already past, an
  unpaid $192 card unchanged through a move, two unpaid months with Mark paid on the newer one first, the membership cases, the correction case,
  Last day in Nov, Dec, Feb 2027 and Feb 2028, the 31st, a charge day that is the switch-on day, and a 7-month run with six moves where the cards
  add up to every booked game exactly once). tests/venue-alert.test.ts "review fixes" now expects the Nov 26 membership card to stay through a move.

### 2. F-15: a late dropper Alex puts back In keeps no late-drop mark (server/admin.ts editRoster)
- The Players sheet's In (and Add) after a late drop now clears the mark the same way the player's own I'm in does (`clearLateDrop`). The money
  already followed the player's own path (joinSession: the debt ends, a host who comes back alone gets the guest's $14 back): checked equal for
  a paid $28 pair (Paid $14, $14 credit) and an unpaid pair (owes $14), both ways. Before, the mark stayed: the late-drop count stayed 1 and, after a
  move to another day, a normal drop read "Late drop" on the card.
- Tests: 5 in tests/zip51-edgecases.test.ts (self and organizer the same, the pair money, an open debt still cannot go to the waitlist, Finalize
  after the In charges the normal $14, the move-then-drop case).

### 3. F-16: the Drop out dialog's money is checked again when the player taps it (shared/dropQuote.ts)
- Found while building: the player screen holds its live updates while any sheet is open, so the dialog could be old for as long as it stayed
  open, not just seconds.
- The phone builds a short "quote" from the money its dialog shows (in or waiting; early or late; owes or not and the amount; "stays" or "owe";
  a host's spots short; credit back; an unconfirmed I paid; the guest). At the tap it asks the server once (GET /api/group): different, and the
  dialog stays open with "This just changed." in bold and the real words, nothing is sent. The same: the 5-second Undo starts as before.
- At the send (POST withdraw with the quote) the server works the quote out again from the same view the screen gets. Different: 409
  "drop_changed", nothing moves, and the phone reloads and opens the dialog again with the real words. Matching: the seat's own UPDATE also checks,
  in the same statement, that "the game is left short" (and a pair's second spot) is still what was shown, so two drops in the same instant can
  never charge a different amount than the screen said. If that check refuses while the screen would still say the same thing (the two counts
  disagree, which no test has found), the drop goes ahead as before so nobody is stuck in.
- A note left by a page that closed during the Undo carries the quote too: a changed amount drops nothing later. An older page sends no quote and
  drops as before; a seat already out answers as before ("not_in_session").
- Tests: 8 in tests/zip51-edgecases.test.ts (the cancel-by second: shown "$14 back", real $14 kept; shown $14 owed, Gale joins, real $0; shown $0,
  Casey drops, real $14; a pair shown $14 then $28; a matching quote; no quote; a seat already out; the race inside withdraw).

## Zip 51b: Money change note (Alex, Mon Nov 16, 2026)
Branch `claude/new-session-uyfl03`, built on main `3dd6468` (Zip 51 live). LIVE since Mon Nov 16, 11:29 AM Eastern with the row OFF (Alex tested
it on the preview and asked for it the same day, ahead of the Wednesday window; see Deploy below). New Settings > Feature switches row **Money change note** (task_log `money_note_on`), ships OFF; no schema change, no Cloudflare
variable, no text or Telegram.

### What it does (only while the row is on)
When what a player owes changes because of someone else, that player's screen opens on one amber alert card (the Venue charge alert's card family,
`AlertCard tone="amber"`), the sentence and one button, Got it. Alex's words (shared/moneyNote.ts `moneyNoteText`):
- a sub takes your late-dropped spot: "Rowan took your spot. Your $14 is cleared." (the game's own price: $11 for a 1.5 hour game)
- a host with a guest, a sub takes one of the 2 spots: "Rowan took one of your 2 spots. $14 is cleared, $14 still owed."
- the game moved to another day (Zip 49 clears the late drop): "Thu's game moved. Your late drop is cleared." (the day it was on, Eastern)
- the organizer puts you back In after a late drop that still owed (F-15): "You're back in. Your late drop is cleared."
Only the person whose money changed, once per event (Got it is kept on the server, so every phone of that player stops showing it), never for
the player's own action (their own drop, their own I'm in), never for an event before the row went on, nothing for the organizer's own seat.
A cleared fee that has a note is no longer also told by the blue "Good news" line (the same clear never shows twice); canceled games and the
organizer's own Clear keep the Good news line as before.

### How it is stored (no schema change)
All in task_log at group level (session_id NULL, like the switches and the venue Mark paid rows): the row `money_note_on` (its time is the
no-backfill start; a second "on" keeps it), `money_note_seen:<id>` per Got it, and `money_note_back_in` (detail: game and player) written by
the organizer's In only while the row is on. Group level on purpose: a move to another day clears that game's own marks (server/tasks.ts), which
would otherwise bring a Got it note back. The sub and moved notes are read from the History lines the site already writes ("late_fee_cleared");
while the row is on, the moved line also carries `from` (the old start) for the weekday. Off: the one switch question every switch asks (answered
from the shared switch read, no extra trip with Fewer trips on), no other read, no write, every answer exactly main's.

  subs a minute apart; moved (old day) and same-day moves (nothing); back In after an owing late drop (note) and after a free one (none); her own
